text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-98765 — PROD runtime-proxy — high 5xx rate detected (threshold 0.5%) — link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-98765

pagerduty-bot: incident escalated to oncall-sre. auto-resolve timeout 5m.

maya: ack'd — taking first look. pinging metrics while I spin up quick queries. :mag:

alex: thx maya. any idea if customers are impacted? I see a small uptick on the dashboard but not widespread.

maya: quick check: p95 latency ok, error rate concentrated on proxy shard-a. running: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/query?m=5xx_rate` and grabbing last 10m.

sre-lead: heads-up — this pattern smells like the autoscaler rapid spin (we saw similar yesterday). could be churned pods hitting the old proxy route before warmup. if it is, PD will flap and auto-resolve.

maya: grabbing controller logs now, filtering for pod restarts: ```
kubectl -n prod get events --field-selector reason=Killing -o wide | tail -n 20
# shows 3 restarts on runtime-proxy-a-1 between 3543209940 and 3543210000
```

alex: :thinking_face: if pods restarted can we confirm if KV cache misses spiked? that would explain transient 5xxs while caches warm.

maya: good call — hitting cache metrics: `kv_cache_hit_ratio{deployment="runtime-proxy"}` — ratio dropped from 0.98 to 0.42 for shard-a at 3543209960 then recovered by 3543210040.

pagerduty-bot: PD-98765 auto-resolved (no ack escalation).

maya: looks like it auto-resolved while I was mid-check. no open PD now. I still see ~3 restarts correlated with a k8s node drain event from infra.

sre-lead: thanks — assign root cause to infra node maintenance that started without draining the proxy gracefully. low blast radius, no customer-facing errors reported from support. mark P0? I think P2 and file a follow-up.

alex: agreed P2. can we add a short mitigation doc for future: ensure node drain hook triggers proxy flush and KV-prefill before termination.

maya: filing a tiny follow-up ticket: INFRA-412 with suggested pre-drain hook and a canary check. cc @sam for next-day follow-up.

sam: saw the cc — will pick this up on morning shift, add canary, and coordinate with infra to land drain hook. thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:

maya: closing thread here — no customer impact, transient spike, PD auto-resolved. leaving logs & metrics links in INFRA-412.

sre-lead: +1. good quick catch and cleanup.

maya: 10-4, handoff complete.
